summary: Modern Mining Technology Corp. engages in the recovery and refining of precious and critical metals from electronic waste in Canada. The company processes discarded printed circuit boards, old phones, and AI chips to extract metals, including gold, silver, palladium, and copper. It operates a pre-concentration plant that separates metals from plastics and epoxy resins using water-based methods to produce metallic sands concentrate. The company also operates an aqueous purification plant that refines metallic sands concentrate through hydrometallurgical techniques to isolate and purify individual metals for sale into industrial supply chains and commodity markets. In addition, it sells metallic sands concentrate as a partially refined intermediate product to downstream metal recyclers. Modern Mining Technology Corp. was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
